query:
SELECT g AS "g!" FROM (
                 SELECT t.guild_id AS g
                 FROM delivery_targets t
                 WHERE delivery_application(t.guild_id, t.delivery_application_id) = $1
                 UNION
                 SELECT w.guild_id AS g
                 FROM delivery_webhooks w
                 WHERE w.application_id = $1
             ) s
             ORDER BY g
